prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent web character portrait for a visual-novel-style virtual receptionist overlay
Primary request: Create one original fictional Filipina luxury resort receptionist, welcoming the guest with a warm professional expression and a natural open-hand gesture.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background.
Subject: adult Filipina woman in a refined resort uniform—tailored warm-ivory jacket or blouse with restrained antique-gold trim and dark espresso lower garment; no readable name badge.
Style/medium: high-end semi-realistic editorial digital illustration with softly sculpted detail; polished and elegant, not anime and not a children’s cartoon.
Composition/framing: vertical full figure or near-full figure, three-quarter front pose, face and both hands fully visible, clean organic silhouette, generous transparent margin for responsive cropping.
Lighting/mood: warm tropical resort hospitality, soft directional light, calm and trustworthy.
Color palette: warm ivory, espresso brown, antique gold, very restrained muted botanical green.
Constraints: transparent alpha background; one person only; no text; no logo; no watermark; no desk; no cropped hands; respectful professional presentation.
Avoid: uncanny photorealism, exaggerated proportions, revealing clothing, busy props, flat vector clip art.
processing: Original built-in generation retained. The saved PNG already had a clean alpha silhouette, verified on light ivory and dark espresso backgrounds; no matte thresholding or geometric mask was applied. Converted with ImageMagick to WebP quality 90, alpha-quality 100, method 6 at original dimensions. An opaque checkerboard edit was rejected and is not used.
